notes: All 470 pieces of the parts list are present and each type/colour count matches the list.
Minifigure bodies/heads/hair are not in the parts list and are not recorded.

Build order follows the booklet: bag 1 steps 1-46, bag 2 steps 47-55, bookcase sub-build (b292-b333) placed in step 56, steps 57-59, sofa, armchair, steps 62-68, whiteboard, shopping cart (step 70), then loose accessories.

The remaining separate groups are real and kept on purpose: (1) the whiteboard easel (b426-b436) and (2) the shopping cart (b437-b450) are free-standing models the booklet builds and sets down beside the room (pages 103, 106, 107), not attached to the baseplate; (3) the Kitchen Implements Kit items (b453-b467: spare fork, knives, plates, cupcake holders, dish, spatula, pan, jug, mixer) and the brick separator (b469) have no building step at all - they are minifigure accessories/a tool, so no brick connection exists for them.

Connected where the booklet shows it: the two forks b451/b452 are placed on the round table (page 106), the dog b468 stands on the baseplate, the sticker sheet b470 is applied to the door and the post.

Sideways book stacks, wall tiles and lamps on 1x1 bricks with side studs are recorded as other_joins, not rests_on. Where booklet icons were ambiguous, parts were assigned so per-type totals match the list; rests_on for some wall bricks may be off by a neighbouring brick.
